name: Fascial GunKh-320 Muscle Massagers Fitness Vibrations Body Care
description:
Brand: Non-Brand
Warranty: No Warranty
Material: Plastic, Leather, Stainless Steel
Colour: Black
Country of Origin: China

Product Features:

Targets deep layers of tendons, muscle tissue, and fascia for effective relief without causing pain.

Ergonomically designed in a pistol shape for a comfortable grip and easy handling.

Includes 4 interchangeable nozzles to target specific muscle groups: legs, buttocks, back, chest, wrists, and ankles.

Optimal session duration: 15 minutes per area.

Powered by a built-in 24V 2400mAh battery.

Amplitude of oscillation: 12 mm (0.47 inch) for deep tissue massage.

Operating frequency: 50 Hz.

Motor speed: 1200–3300 rpm.

Charging time: 2 hours; Working time: up to 6 hours.

Input voltage: 220V; Battery-powered for cordless convenience.

Dimensions: 24 × 24.5 × 51 cm

Perfect for: Athletes, fitness enthusiasts, and anyone looking to relieve muscle tension, improve blood circulation, and enhance recovery.
